How to Order

Three easy steps — no account to create, no advance payment to make.

1

Choose Your Product

Browse the store, pick what you like, and check its price and details carefully before ordering.

2

Tap a Product & Fill the Form

Tap any product to open its order form, choose your quantity and fill in your name, mobile number, city and complete address.

3

Confirm on WhatsApp & Pay at Your Door

Tap “Confirm Order on WhatsApp” — your filled order opens in WhatsApp, ready to send. The courier then brings your parcel to your door and you pay cash on delivery.

Frequently Asked Questions

Read this before you order — most answers are right here.

How do I pay? +

Cash on Delivery only. There is no advance payment — when the courier brings your parcel home, check the product and pay at that moment.

How long does delivery take? +

Once your order is confirmed, your parcel is handed to the courier. Delivery usually takes 2–3 days in major cities and 3–5 days in other areas. The exact timeframe will be confirmed on WhatsApp when you order.

What are the delivery charges? +

Delivery charges are already included in every product price — the total you see is the total you pay, with nothing added afterwards.

What if the product arrives damaged or wrong? +

Check your parcel as soon as it arrives. If the product is damaged or not what you ordered, send us a photo on WhatsApp right away — we will do our best to resolve it.

How do I track my order? +

Every update — dispatch, in transit and delivery — will be sent to the same WhatsApp number you placed your order from.
